text:
The builder is likely to recover $14,000 in expectation damages: the $20,000 contract price minus the $5,000 remaining cost to complete and minus the $1,000 saved by reselling unused materials. The $9,000 spent framing and $1,000 spent on unincorporated materials are costs incurred that are subsumed within this expectation measure, and the $3,000 added property value does not cap recovery. The homeowner's wrongful stop-work order was a breach, so the builder recovers the profit he would have made plus costs not otherwise offset.

CONFIDENCE: 82
